answer_1.quote: Given the training set D consists of n data points (s i , p i , c i ), i = 1, ..., n, where each element denotes a song, the description of its accompaniment and music score of its vocal, we convert the music score to song conditioned on the natural language prompt

answer_2.quote: We also calculate the F0 Frame Error (FFE) for objective evaluation... For the objective evaluation, we calculate the Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD), Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KLD), and the CLAP score (CLAP).

answer_4.quote: we conduct a crowd-sourced human evaluation via Amazon Mechanical Turk... we asked the raters to evaluate the audio samples in terms of overall quality (OVL), relevance to the prompt (REL), and alignment with the melody (MEL.)
answer_4.guideline: Raters were instructed for MOS: focus on audio quality and naturalness; for SMOS: focus on speaker similarity; for accompaniment: evaluate OVL, REL, and MEL.
